mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen monotonically for four consecutive weekly means (-8.7, -10.4, -11.3, -12.3); the decline is a persistent trip-suppression trend rather than noise, so the next 28-day mean stays below the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly means decline in all four observed weeks from -8.7 to -12.3
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the 28 days after 2021-11-15 is greater than the last-28-day mean of approximately -10.7, i.e. the four-week decline reverses.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS collapses from +20.3 to -8.0 over four weeks, marking the onset of cold-weather conditions; outdoor leisure trips are displaced indoors into retail and hospitality venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS four-week mean falls below 0 percent
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS drops 28.3 points across the four observed weeks, crossing from positive to negative territory
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds above 0 while RETAIL_REC continues to decline, or RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days remains at or below -12.0 despite PARKS staying negative.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT reaches -22.3 in the most recent week, its worst reading of the window; when the transit four-week mean crosses below -22 the pool of discretionary trip-chains feeding shopping districts shrinks, driving RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean falls below -22 percent
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT hits -22.3 at t-0w, the lowest of the four weekly means and below the prior-week -19.3
failure_condition: In the seven days after 2021-11-15 RETAIL_REC rises even though TRANSIT remains below -22, or TRANSIT recovers above -19 and RETAIL_REC still falls.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of WORKPLACES stuck near -12 and RESIDENTIAL holding a positive +4.0 means daytime population is redistributed into residential districts rather than office cores; neighbourhood-serving retail recaptures those trips, pushing RETAIL_REC up over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above +3.0 while WORKPLACES stays below -10
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES sits at -12.1 in the last two weeks while RESIDENTIAL is positive in all four weeks, peaking at +4.9
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +3.0 and WORKPLACES below -10, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The persistent 20-plus point gap between GROCERY_PHARM (+10.9) and RETAIL_REC (-12.3) shows health-pass enforcement diverting trips to essential-only venues; while that gap holds, discretionary retail stays suppressed over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap exceeds 20 percentage points
evidence_refs: fact:the GROCERY_PHARM to RETAIL_REC gap is 23.2 points at t-0w and has stayed above 20 points in all four weeks
regime_hint: health-pass enforcement with capacity limits on discretionary venues
failure_condition: The gap falls below 20 points because RETAIL_REC rises while GROCERY_PHARM is flat, or RETAIL_REC falls further despite the gap narrowing.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained double-digit deficits in both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES mean aggregate daily trip-chains remain structurally below baseline; fewer chains feed fewer incidental retail stops, keeping the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean below the prior 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has been below -17 in all four weeks and WORKPLACES below -12 in all four weeks
failure_condition: The 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC after 2021-11-15 exceeds its prior 28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -12.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding at or above +10 for four straight weeks indicates households are still consolidating trips into essential errands; when that essential-trip share is this high, precautionary behaviour spills over and RETAIL_REC weakens within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean stays at or above +10 percent for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is +11.1, +9.3, +11.9, +10.9 across the four weekly means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week after 2021-11-15 while GROCERY_PHARM remains at or above +10, or GROCERY_PHARM falls below +8 and RETAIL_REC still declines.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-November onward is the pre-holiday shopping ramp; even with RETAIL_REC at -12.3, the calendar pull plus the collapse in outdoor PARKS activity should redirect spend indoors, raising the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean above the prior one.
evidence_refs: fact:decision point 2021-11-15 sits seven weeks before the holiday retail peak while PARKS is at -8.0 and TRANSIT at -22.3
regime_hint: pre-holiday seasonal upswing under lingering mobility restrictions
failure_condition: The 28-day RETAIL_REC mean after 2021-11-15 is below the prior 28-day mean of roughly -10.7, showing the holiday seasonal pull failed to overcome the mobility drag.
